question: How many countries have gini recalculated lower than the world average in 2015?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS CountryCount  FROM (     SELECT DISTINCT ON (country, year)     FROM country_income     WHERE year = 2015 AND gini_recalculated < (         SELECT AVG(gini_recalculated)         FROM country_income ci2         WHERE YEAR(ci2.year) <= 2015     ) ) AS filtered_data;
